In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the canine saphhenous vein is endowed with 5-HT1, 5-HT2 and 5-HT1-like receptors.

the saphhenous vein of the canine species is endowed with a prejunctional 5HT1-like receptor and a postjunctional 1D and 2 receptor, all of which are able to mediate their effects by activating the same effector mechanism.

in the canine saphena the 5-HT receptor subtypes are not clearly separated, but are overlapping.

the saphenos vein of dogs has pre- and post-junctional 5-HT receptor types.
